gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Nippo draws its letters like cable, every stroke holding one thickness. Noto Sans Vithkuqi does the opposite job, keeping its open-throated letters and small capital-to-lowercase step easy to follow where Nippo simply stands out.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-yi: Wire-cut and technical, Nippo draws outlines in a single width. Noto Sans Yi gives the lowercase a deep midsection and hooked, unsealed rounds, so extended reading feels open and unhurried.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squa: Small letters standing almost as tall as capitals, cut like wire, give Nippo its technical edge. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square, with its soaring x-height and wide gaps, feels friendlier beside it, relaxed where Nippo is exacting.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Noto Traditional Nushu reads like a broad-nibbed pen, its bowls filling the line and never curling shut. And Nippo, with curves matching its stems exactly, keeps the heading crisp while this sans carries page after page without strain.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-numans: Nippo stands its small letters nearly capital-tall, like cut wire. Numans swells its lowercase like coiled rope and tracks wide, which makes the pressure-free wire of Nippo the sharpest foil.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-parkinsans: Crisp, wiry and technical, Nippo keeps its small letters nearly capital-sized. Parkinsans mirrors that stature with lowercase rising close to capitals, and its wide-mouthed letters stay crisp when shrunk, which is the real link.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens each letter like a pried oyster shell, lofty in its x-height. Preahvihear stays breezy across a full page of text, a sans that sits comfortably under the bent-tubing letterforms of Nippo.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-pt-sans-caption: Drafting-pen steady and cut like wire, Nippo looks technical at a glance. PT Sans Caption brings inviting, unclosed bowls and big-bodied lowercase, and that warmth set against the drafted precision of Nippo is the best thing here.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-puritan: Puritan has a friendly, rounded read, with oversized counters in the e and a that stay clearly open to the side. Nippo, hairline-free and shadow-free, supplies the crisp edge: softness meets precision.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-questrial: Questrial reads flat and stencil-cut, every stroke of a single weight, with short stalks above a tall letter band. And Nippo, with its wire-cut small letters, shares that flat precision, which is what holds the two together.
